question: What bodily form results from constant practice of this yoga over time?
premises: The means is constant practice through yoga
A time period of sixteen years is indicated
A resulting form is said to come into being
inference: Through constant yogic practice, one may attain the form of a sixteen-year-old.
uncertainties: dvi-aṣṭa-varṣa-ākṛtiḥ is interpreted as the form or appearance of sixteen years
plain_english: Through constant yogic practice, one may attain the form of a sixteen-year-old.
